name: 2024-2c-parcial1
title: Monsters and Adventurers
description: A small RPG combat model: warriors and mages equip swords, staffs, armors and magic shields to fight goblins and ogres, with type-dependent penalties. The student must implement the whole model from a given, unmodifiable test class whose creation methods are left unimplemented.
solutionPackages: solution/2024-2C-Parcial 1 Paso a paso con bonus.zip

design.notes: Attack damage depends on both the item kind and the adventurer kind (and on the monster kind for the staff), so the temptation is to ask objects their type; the tests fix the protocol (equiparItemDeAtaque:, atacarA:con:, tienePuntosDeVida:) and use Aconcagua units (pv), and the optional bonus adds a defeated state.
